supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Pronounced lateral extension of the brow ridge visible beyond the outer corner of the eye

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the depigmented (pale) muzzle and chin region and the heavily melanized (dark) periocular and cheek regions

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Lower lip displays moderate vertical thickness and a structural downward droop

other_distinctive_markers: Bright pinkish-orange depigmentation patch on the chin and lower lip
